front.title: Red Sox clinch playoff berth thanks to help from grandson of team legend
front.tldr: Mike Yastrzemski, grandson of Red Sox legend Carl Yastrzemski, hit the home run that clinched Boston's playoff spot on Sunday, capping a late-season turnaround.

front.title: Zach Cregger's Resident Evil grossed more on opening weekend than the original made in its entire run
front.tldr: The Weapons and Barbarian director's new film opened to $108.3 million, making Cregger one of Hollywood's most reliable hitmakers three films in.

front.title: GM revives CarPlay for 2027 trucks
front.tldr: General Motors is reversing its push to drop Apple CarPlay, restoring it for 2027 Chevrolet Silverado and GMC Sierra trucks after owner pushback.

stories.title: World model companies are keeping a lot of secrets
stories.tldr: Despite huge funding and buzz around world models, founders, investors and even their own data suppliers are reluctant to explain what the technology actually does.

stories.title: Vocci's ring adds a new form factor to meeting note-taking
stories.tldr: The $249 wearable ring records and summarises meetings hands-free, though its always-on listening raises the same privacy questions as other AI note-takers.

stories.title: ScrollEd wants to turn textbooks into TikTok
stories.tldr: The Palo Alto startup, founded by student couple Utsav Gupta and Rebecca Neff, turns textbooks into a scrollable feed of video, audio and quizzes.

stories.title: A small but growing number of founders are betting on bringing people together offline
stories.tldr: From a game console maker to a leathercraft school, founders are building businesses around real-world connection as a reaction to screen fatigue.

stories.title: Elon Musk's latest Boring Company pitch involves a Hyperloop between Austin and San Antonio
stories.tldr: The Boring Company has floated a new Hyperloop route between the two Texas cities, though most of its previously announced projects have yet to materialise.

stories.title: TechCrunch Mobility: how do we know when an AV is safe enough?
stories.tldr: TechCrunch's transport newsletter examines how regulators and companies are trying to define a safety bar for autonomous vehicles as AI takes on a bigger role.

stories.title: iFixit shares iPhone 18 Pro teardown with inside look at new features
stories.tldr: iFixit's teardown of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max confirms battery capacities and gives the clearest look yet at the phone's internals.

stories.title: Siri AI settlement website now live: Apple to pay some iPhone owners
stories.tldr: Apple's $250 million settlement over Siri's delayed AI launch is now open for claims, with eligible iPhone owners in line for about $25 each.

stories.title: Five ways the new Siri AI is frustrating iPhone and Apple Watch users
stories.tldr: Siri AI is rolling out gradually as a labelled beta, and early users report it still falls short in several everyday situations.

stories.title: India's Angh wins Toronto Platform Award, nabs automatic Oscar contention
stories.tldr: Theja Rio's debut feature about an indigenous Indian tribe in the 1960s took Toronto's Platform prize, which comes with automatic Oscar shortlist eligibility.

stories.title: La Bola Negra wins Oscar-predictive Toronto Film Festival People's Choice Award
stories.tldr: Javier Calvo and Javier Ambrossi's Cannes breakout won Toronto's audience award, a prize with a strong record of predicting eventual Oscar contenders.

stories.title: Ke Huy Quan reveals life-changing gesture from Spielberg and Lucas when he was a kid
stories.tldr: In his new memoir, the Oscar winner recalls receiving a $100,000 residual cheque for Indiana Jones and the Temple of Doom as a 12-year-old actor.

stories.title: Duncan Jones on why it's harder than ever to make his kind of movies, and why he refused to use AI for his newest one
stories.tldr: The Moon and Mute director took almost a decade to get his animated Rogue Trooper adaptation made, and did it without generative AI.

stories.title: Entering year 5, what should we make of Joe Mazzulla?
stories.tldr: As Mazzulla starts his fifth season as Celtics head coach, CelticsBlog weighs what his body of work says about him so far.

stories.title: Game Observations: 8 takeaways from the Patriots' win over the Steelers in Week 2
stories.tldr: New England beat Pittsburgh 20-3 at Gillette Stadium on Sunday, a defensive performance that included four sacks of Aaron Rodgers and two turnovers.

stories.title: Mike Onwenu reportedly suffers season-ending ankle injury against Steelers
stories.tldr: X-rays reportedly showed the veteran guard broke his right ankle after being rolled up from behind in the second quarter of Sunday's win.

stories.title: Why Ferrari has fallen back, and what it plans to do

stories.tldr: Ex-Ferrari and Williams engineer Rob Smedley wants a bigger stewarding team to speed up in-race calls and stop straightforward incidents dragging on.
